title: Food Supplement for Individuals With Polygenic Hypercholesterolaemia
official: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Three-Arm, Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial With Open-Label Extension to Evaluate the Efficacy of Phytosterols and a Combined Dietary Supplement (Normolip® Colesterolo) on Non-HDL Cholesterol
summary:
Atherogenic dyslipidaemia is a key modifiable determinant of cardiovascular risk. Non-HDL-C provides a comprehensive estimate of atherogenic cholesterol burden. In primary prevention, adults with polygenic hypercholesterolaemia often require dietary and lifestyle interventions, but these may not yield sufficient lipid improvements.

This study evaluates the efficacy of a combined nutraceutical (phytosterols + bergamot dry extract + artichoke dry extract) and phytosterols alone, versus placebo, on non-HDL-C change in adults with polygenic hypercholesterolaemia. The three-arm design assesses the primary placebo-controlled comparison and the incremental effect of the combined formulation.

Secondary analyses explore changes in lipid fractions and inflammatory indices. An open-label extension evaluates changes through 12 weeks. The goal is to provide evidence for well-tolerated adjunctive options for lipid management.
